title: Global coastal cities commit to mangrove restoration corridor
body: A coalition of 40 coastal cities agreed to restore a continuous mangrove corridor along the world's tropical coastlines, combining flood defense with habitat recovery.

title: Deep-ocean sensors report record oxygen levels at 4,000m
body: New autonomous buoys deployed across the Pacific are sending back the highest dissolved-oxygen readings ever recorded at depth, reshaping models of deep circulation.

title: Sample return capsule confirms lunar water isotopes match Earth's
body: Laboratory analysis of the returned lunar samples confirms hydrogen isotope ratios identical to Earth's deep mantle, strengthening the giant-impact theory.

title: Urban rooftops bloom: city bee counts double in five years
body: Surveyed rooftop gardens across 120 cities report native bee populations doubled since 2021, as pollinator corridors connect green rooftops into working networks.

title: Grid-scale sand batteries smooth winter solar storage
body: Pilot sand-battery plants in northern latitudes are proving seasonal heat storage at gigawatt-hour scale, cutting winter reliance on fossil peakers.

title: First treaty on high-seas marine parks enters force
body: The high-seas biodiversity treaty is now binding, creating the legal backbone for a network of protected areas across 30% of the open ocean.

title: Ice-core record extends climate history by 1.2 million years
body: A deep ice core from the Antarctic plateau has pushed the continuous climate record past 1.2 million years, revealing new glacial cycles.

title: Rewilded river deltas absorb storm surge in first field test
body: Reconnected floodplains in three major deltas absorbed measurable storm-surge energy during last season's cyclones, validating large-scale rewilding.
